Onkel Hasan in Innsbruck

** Discover the vibrant flavors of the **Orient** in the heart of the **Alps**! At **Onkel Hasan**, a cozy restaurant in **Innsbruck**, you’ll experience an unforgettable culinary journey through the Middle East and beyond. Our menu is a symphony of spices, fresh ingredients, and traditional recipes—from fragrant **Shawarma** and tender **Döner Kebabs** to aromatic **Lamb Tagine** and crispy **Falafel**. Don’t miss our famous **Baklava**, a sweet masterpiece that melts in your mouth. Whether you’re craving a hearty **Meze** platter to share with friends or a comforting bowl of **Lentil Soup**, **Onkel Hasan** offers something for every palate. Pair your meal with a glass of Turkish tea, a refreshing **Ayran**, or one of our fine wines. Located in the charming **Innsbrucker Altstadt**, just a stone’s throw from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the lively **Herz-Jesu-Kirche**, we’re your perfect stop for a taste of the world—right in **Tirol**. Come visit us and let the flavors transport you to a different world!
